fixed.summary: Every option method now returns through a private derived(Options) helper that builds new Proxy(target, next, watchdog), so a watchdog installed with withWatchdog is carried forward; the Options constructor is untouched and withWatchdog's javadoc no longer says to call it last. New test rel_PROXY_001_aWatchdogSurvivesLaterOptionMethods (withWatchdog then retries(0).maxConcurrent(1).totalTimeout(7s)) failed before the fix and passes after: one reservation on the installed watchdog for 7 s.

Extracted the response-header block of forward into private applyResponseHeaders(req, res, head), keeping the order copy -> Location rewrite -> .responseHeader values (FR-PROXY-012); res.status still runs first in forward. No behavior change.
EndOrder javadoc reworded from 'The three orders' to 'The four ways the relayed stream's close and the abort notification may end the exchange.' Comment only.
Assertion messages 'counter/reservation cancels after the copy ended' reworded to '... after the client gave up'. Assertion logic unchanged, no new wait added.
